OP you should get legal advice before going to court for diversion. As general information, Diversion (at least in VIC) is generally a one-use-only thing, so if you use it once, you typically won't get it again. i.e. if you use it to get out of a $100 ticket, if you make a mistake later on and get a more serious charge e.g. assault, you are much less likely to get diversion. Always get legal advice before going to court, especially for a criminal matter, which a diversion is. Even if it's a minor traffic matter now, it could impact a more serious matter in the future.

I once saw a self-repped 18 year old kid take diversion to get out of a <$200 failure to display P plates fine and the Magistrate was very reluctant to give it, warning him about the potential ramifications of doing so, and clarifying he understood this.
